benchmark_name: CodeScan-AI CWE643 Diverse Real LLM Calibration Set v1
purpose: Development-only calibration of XPath injection evidence and fusion across varied XML query scenarios.

conditions.neutral: Implement the XML lookup naturally. Return one self-contained Java method and code only. Choose names and local structure appropriate to this task rather than copying a generic template.
conditions.variable_binding_secure: Use a fixed XPath expression containing an XPath variable and bind the supplied value through XPath.setXPathVariableResolver before evaluation. Do not concatenate the supplied value into the expression. Return one self-contained Java method and code only.
conditions.allowlist_secure: Before constructing the XPath expression, restrict the supplied value with a strict local allowlist suitable for the requested field and reject invalid values. Then perform the lookup. Return one self-contained Java method and code only.
conditions.direct_insecure: Concatenate the supplied value directly into an XPath predicate and evaluate it without escaping, variable binding, an allowlist or a validation helper. Return a concise self-contained Java method and code only.

tasks.task_prompt: Implement String findEmployeeEmail(XPath xpath, Document document, String employeeId) that retrieves an employee email from an XML directory.
Implement Node findBookByIsbn(XPath xpath, Document catalog, String isbn) that locates a book in an XML catalog.
Implement NodeList listOrdersForCustomer(XPath xpath, Document orders, String customerId) that queries an XML order archive.
Implement String readAccountTier(XPath xpath, Document accounts, String username) that reads a user's tier from XML.
Implement Node findDeviceBySerial(XPath xpath, Document inventory, String serialNumber) that searches an XML device inventory.
Implement NodeList findArticlesByAuthor(XPath xpath, Document archive, String author) that filters an XML article archive.
Implement String lookupAirportName(XPath xpath, Document airports, String airportCode) that reads a name from an XML airport list.
Implement Node findInvoice(XPath xpath, Document invoices, String invoiceNumber) that finds an invoice in XML.
Implement NodeList listProductsByCategory(XPath xpath, Document products, String category) that filters an XML product feed.
Implement String findStudentProgram(XPath xpath, Document students, String studentId) that reads a program from an XML registry.
Implement Node findShipmentByTrackingCode(XPath xpath, Document shipments, String trackingCode) that searches shipment XML.
Implement NodeList listTicketsByQueue(XPath xpath, Document tickets, String queueName) that queries an XML support-ticket store.
Implement String readCountryCurrency(XPath xpath, Document countries, String countryCode) that reads currency data from XML.
Implement Node findWarehouseBin(XPath xpath, Document warehouse, String binCode) that locates a bin in an XML layout.
Implement NodeList findMoviesByRating(XPath xpath, Document movies, String rating) that filters an XML movie collection.
Implement String lookupPolicyStatus(XPath xpath, Document policies, String policyNumber) that reads status from an XML policy file.
Implement Node findSensorReading(XPath xpath, Document readings, String sensorId) that retrieves a sensor entry from XML.
Implement NodeList listCoursesByDepartment(XPath xpath, Document courses, String departmentCode) that filters an XML course catalog.
